offers_products.reason: Makes choline, encapsulated nutrients, chelated minerals, food ingredients and packaged specialty gases.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured ingredients and gases; no main service offering beyond technical support.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells ingredients to food, feed, supplement makers, farmers and industrial users, not directly to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are food and beverage makers, feed producers, supplement brands, agricultural firms and gas users.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ingredients and gases are repeat-order consumables bought continually by manufacturers and feed producers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Nutrition, food and feed ingredients are staples; demand is fairly stable in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Frequent repeat purchases of ingredients, minerals and gases, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value is in manufactured ingredients and encapsulation technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are large food, feed and nutrition manufacturers and distributors, though some smaller customers exist.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates chemical manufacturing plants and gas packaging and distribution; growth needs plant capacity and acquisitions.
